spec: DACS-4 §9.5.9 DEM-1..DEM-7; DEMOS-MAPPING §A.2 native-send record profile; §9.5.1 PC-4/PC-7; §9.5.8 SB-2; §9.7.0 FV-5
description: Inclusion does not prove execution. Only a getTxByHash record from a pinned node that decodes under the native-send record profile and binds the retained hash, nonce, block, sender, recipient and OS amount with status confirmed and independent applied-payment authority succeeds; a bound failed record is a permanent failure; anything else is a substrate result without a second broadcast.

demosProfile.liveObservations: node2-* vectors copy read-only node2.demos.sh getTxByHash responses of 2026-10-17; the node reported 61b8e75 with a dirty tree, so they are observations, not the source pin

fixtureVocabulary.statusIndex: getTransactionStatus state for the retained hash (included, pending or unknown); never decisive
fixtureVocabulary.network: the phase's Demos network (networkId, genesisHash) as its binding pins it; applied-payment authority must name the same network, and a missing or malformed one binds nothing
fixtureVocabulary.inclusionObservation: block number and, when observed, block ID (blockId) that include the retained hash or the signed txRef, or null; applied-payment authority must name the same block ID, and without one it binds no block identity
fixtureVocabulary.recordRead: getTxByHash read: found (record and nodeBuild), not-found or unavailable; appliedTransfer (networkId, genesisHash, blockId, txHash, blockNumber, sender, recipient, payerDebitOs, payeeCreditOs, committedBalances: payerBeforeOs, payerAfterOs, payeeBeforeOs, payeeAfterOs, feeOs) and appliedTransferAuthenticated model separate authenticated committed state-transition authority, never derived from the record's status, amount or edits; payerDebitOs must be payerBeforeOs - payerAfterOs - feeOs and payeeCreditOs must be payeeAfterOs - payeeBeforeOs, or the authority establishes nothing; the fixtures take the committed balances from the scenario's own pre-state and outcome (applied, rolled-back or no-op)
fixtureVocabulary.nodeBuild: the build attestation the Demos binding configuration holds for the node that served the read (source binding-attestation, commit, tree); only binding-attestation of commit 61b8e75aa8db5e408c49e1c3a89db4d673f45578 with a clean tree is pinned, and a self-reported build, another commit or a dirty tree is not
fixtureVocabulary.gcr_edits: a confirmed record establishes success only when its gcr_edits, each txhash blanked, are the four edits of its send; the pinned node applies a missing or empty list as a successful no-op
fixtureVocabulary.otherGates: verdicts of the FV, SB-1 and PB checks that compose with DEM-7 before delivery
fixtureVocabulary.request: the call about to carry the signed transaction out of the handler: confirm-retained (demosdk confirm/confirmTx, which carries signedTransaction), broadcast-retained or broadcast-replacement (demosdk broadcast, which carries validityResponse); these are the profile's only submission route, and any other value is refused, including sr3-proxy-submission and wallet-direct-submission
fixtureVocabulary.signPermitted: pre-sign-gate result, DEM-1 before demosdk pay()/sign(): the input holds no signed transaction; false with ok false and errorClass permanent is the handler's PC-4 result, and nothing is signed or sent
fixtureVocabulary.broadcastState: never-broadcast (nothing has left the handler), confirm-returned (this uninterrupted submission's confirm just returned), confirm-sent-interrupted (a confirm was sent, then a timeout, error or restart) or maybe-broadcast; any other value is refused
fixtureVocabulary.confirmResponse: the demosdk 4.0.16 confirm() result (RPCResponseWithValidityData) that the current submission's confirm returned to the handler, even late, or null; null for a confirm request
fixtureVocabulary.validityResponse: what the demosdk broadcast(validationData) call carries, or null for a confirm request; the pinned node executes its response.data.transaction, so it must be exactly confirmResponse, with result 200, valid true and an embedded transaction whose content, hash and signature serialize as signedTransaction
fixtureVocabulary.pinnedNodeConfigured: the Demos binding pins nodes under the native-send record profile for the phase's network; anything but true is refused
fixtureVocabulary.appliedPaymentAuthorityConfigured: the Demos binding configures an applied-payment authority for that network; anything but true is refused
fixtureVocabulary.proofAuthentication: how the DEM-4 proof's failed record was obtained: fv5-bft-final (FV-5-authenticated at its bft-final inclusion) or rpc-read; anything else is not authenticated
fixtureVocabulary.consumerAdmissions: raw txRef, (jobId, phaseIndex) and legacy (verified legacy evidence) for every otherwise admitted pay-dem record; derive SB-1 IDs, collapsing legacy spellings, before grouping; an admitted reference without an SB-1 ID is error
fixtureVocabulary.guards: checks whose removal makes this vector fail

vectors.name: included-confirmed
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record in the node's wire form is the only success.

vectors.name: node2-confirmed-record
vectors.note: The live confirmed RPC record has no independent applied-transfer authority.

vectors.name: confirmed-integer-nonce-binds
vectors.note: A safe JSON integer nonce projects to the same signed nonce.

vectors.name: confirmed-large-string-amount-binds
vectors.note: Above 2^53 - 1 OS the node serves the amount as a decimal string; it binds by integer value.

vectors.name: confirmed-unprefixed-parties-bind
vectors.note: A party key without the 0x prefix projects to the same DACS-1 key.

vectors.name: confirmed-prefixed-send-argument-binds
vectors.note: A send recipient argument with the 0x prefix projects to the same key; its credit edit names it unchanged.

vectors.name: confirmed-safe-max-number-amount-binds
vectors.note: Up to 2^53 - 1 OS the node serves the amount as a JSON number; that bound itself decodes.

vectors.name: included-failed
vectors.note: Included is not executed: a bound failed record is a durable permanent failure with no replacement.

vectors.name: node2-included-failed-record
vectors.note: A live node2 transfer whose status index said included while its record failed (TX_NONCE_INVALID_LOW).

vectors.name: included-pending
vectors.note: Included with a pending record is unresolved: substrate, re-read only.

vectors.name: included-record-not-found
vectors.note: Included but no record for the retained hash: execution is unknown and nothing is resent.

vectors.name: included-record-unavailable
vectors.note: An unreachable node leaves execution unknown; no success, failure or delivery.

vectors.name: included-alias
vectors.note: A record status copied from the index label is not an execution result.

vectors.name: finalized-alias
vectors.note: Finality vocabulary is not the executed record status.

vectors.name: success-alias
vectors.note: Only the exact Demos record status confirmed establishes execution.

vectors.name: confirmed-case-variant
vectors.note: Status comparison is exact; a case variant is unknown.

vectors.name: confirmed-unpinned-node
vectors.note: A node that only self-reports the pinned commit is not pinned; it may store a failed transfer as confirmed.

vectors.name: failed-unpinned-node
vectors.note: A failed record from an unpinned node proves nothing about execution either.

vectors.name: confirmed-old-build-node
vectors.note: An attested testnet ac8f45f build stores every block transaction as confirmed; it is not the pinned commit.

vectors.name: confirmed-dirty-build-node
vectors.note: The pinned commit built from a modified tree is not the pin.

vectors.name: confirmed-no-op-apply
vectors.note: A confirmed send with no gcr_edits applied nothing: the committed balances did not change.

vectors.name: confirmed-no-op-empty-edits
vectors.note: An empty edit list is the same no-op; confirmed is not payment.

vectors.name: confirmed-no-op-copied-authority
vectors.note: An authority that reports a committed payment for a record without its send's edits cannot establish payment.

vectors.name: confirmed-partial-edits
vectors.note: A confirmed record carrying only the payment's two balance edits is not the send's four edits.

vectors.name: confirmed-reordered-edit-members
vectors.note: Edit members in another order serialize differently from the send's edits.

vectors.name: confirmed-four-edits-uncommitted-payment
vectors.note: Committed balances unchanged by a confirmed send with all four edits: no payment moved.

vectors.name: confirmed-four-edits-authority-not-committed-change
vectors.note: An authority whose debit and credit copy the amount while its committed balances did not change establishes nothing.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A confirmed record for another hash says nothing about the retained transfer.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A record whose nonce differs from the signed nonce is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A record in a different block from the inclusion observation is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-sender
vectors.note: A record debiting another sender is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-recipient
vectors.note: A record paying another recipient is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A record for a different OS amount is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A record missing its nonce does not decode.

vectors.name: confirmed-boolean-nonce
vectors.note: true is not a nonce, even when the signed nonce is 1.

vectors.name: confirmed-fractional-nonce
vectors.note: A non-integer number does not decode as a nonce.

vectors.name: confirmed-leading-zero-nonce
vectors.note: A decimal string with a leading zero is not canonical.

vectors.name: confirmed-fractional-amount
vectors.note: A non-integer amount is not an OS amount.

vectors.name: confirmed-noncanonical-amount
vectors.note: A decimal amount string with a leading zero is not canonical.

vectors.name: confirmed-prefixed-hash
vectors.note: The Demos hash is 64 lowercase hex digits without 0x.

vectors.name: confirmed-uppercase-sender
vectors.note: A party key with uppercase hex does not decode.

vectors.name: confirmed-sender-alias-mismatch
vectors.note: from and from_ed25519_address must name the same key.

vectors.name: confirmed-payload-recipient-mismatch
vectors.note: The native send argument must credit the same recipient as content.to.

vectors.name: confirmed-payload-amount-mismatch
vectors.note: The native send argument must carry the same OS amount as content.amount.

vectors.name: confirmed-not-native-send
vectors.note: Only a native send moves the payment.

vectors.name: confirmed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: Without an inclusion observation neither the record's block nor the applied-payment authority's block ID can be bound.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record with another nonce does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record missing its nonce does not decode, so it proves nothing.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A failed record in another block conflicts with the inclusion observation.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A failed record for another amount does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A failed record for another hash does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-sender
vectors.note: A failed record from another sender does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-recipient
vectors.note: A failed record to another recipient does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: A failed record without an inclusion observation is not a bound failure.

vectors.name: transfer-unknown-not-rebroadcast
vectors.note: The node's status index says unknown and there is no record; the handler still only re-reads.

vectors.name: resume-reuses-failure-proof
vectors.note: A resume after a proven failure reuses it even while the node is unreachable.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof
vectors.note: A retained proof whose nonce no longer binds is not reused; re-read only.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-recipient
vectors.note: A retained proof for another recipient is not reused.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-block
vectors.note: A retained proof whose record is in another block than its inclusion block is not reused.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-status
vectors.note: A retained proof whose record is not failed is not a failure proof.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-not-found
vectors.note: A crash after a possible broadcast resumes by re-reading, never resending.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-confirmed
vectors.note: Re-reading the retained hash finds the executed transfer; no second payment.

vectors.name: first-broadcast-after-durable-retention
vectors.note: The single broadcast, carrying its own confirm's validity response, is allowed once the signed transfer is durably retained for this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-prefixed-send-argument
vectors.note: demosdk passes the send recipient through as given; a 0x-prefixed argument gets no second 0x in the credit edit.

vectors.name: broadcast-before-durable-retention
vectors.note: Volatile retention cannot support recovery, so the broadcast is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-incomplete-retention
vectors.note: A retained transfer without its signed nonce is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-retention-missing-recipient
vectors.note: A retained transfer without its recipient is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-retention-missing-phase
vectors.note: A retained transfer not keyed to a phase index is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-ill-typed-retained-amount
vectors.note: The retained OS amount is a canonical decimal string.

vectors.name: second-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: The same signed bytes are not sent again once they may have been broadcast.

vectors.name: replacement-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: A replacement transfer is never sent for the same job phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-retained-for-another-job
vectors.note: A transfer retained for another job cannot pay this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-retained-for-another-phase
vectors.note: A transfer retained for another phase index of the same job cannot pay this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-from-another-paying-key
vectors.note: A transfer signed by a key other than payer.payingKey is refused, even when retained consistently.

vectors.name: broadcast-to-another-destination
vectors.note: A transfer to a destination other than payee.payeeAddress is refused, even when retained consistently.

vectors.name: broadcast-of-another-amount
vectors.note: A transfer of an amount other than the phase amount in OS is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-nonce-differs
vectors.note: The retained nonce must be the nonce the payer signed.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-sender-differs
vectors.note: An authentic transfer from another key must not replace the retained payer transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-recipient-differs
vectors.note: Signed bytes that pay another destination than the retained recipient are refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-amount-differs
vectors.note: Signed bytes for another amount than the retained OS amount are refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-hash-differs
vectors.note: The retained hash must be the hash of the signed transaction.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-pre-fork-amount
vectors.note: A send signed in the pre-osDenomination form (numeric amount argument) does not decode, so it is never broadcast.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-uppercase-recipient
vectors.note: demosdk accepts an upper-case recipient, but it does not decode under the profile, so it is never broadcast.

vectors.name: broadcast-unsigned-transaction
vectors.note: A claimed transaction without the payer's signature is not a signed transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-hash-not-over-content
vectors.note: A hash and signature made over other content (here another nonce) do not commit to the content retained.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-by-another-key
vectors.note: A signature by a key other than content.from does not authenticate the payer's transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-signature-type-not-ed25519
vectors.note: Only an ed25519 signature by the sender key is verified under the profile.

vectors.name: broadcast-signature-uppercase-hex
vectors.note: The signature data is 0x and 128 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

vectors.name: broadcast-signature-unprefixed-hex
vectors.note: The signature data carries the 0x prefix.

vectors.name: broadcast-signature-extra-member
vectors.note: The signature object has exactly the members type and data.

vectors.name: broadcast-hash-retained-for-another-phase
vectors.note: One signed transfer cannot be retained for, and pay, two phases.

vectors.name: consumer-confirmed-gate-passes
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record passes DEM-7 only; it authorizes no delivery by itself.

vectors.name: consumer-prefixed-send-argument-admitted
vectors.note: A record whose send recipient argument carries the 0x prefix binds the same payee.

vectors.name: consumer-node2-confirmed-refused
vectors.note: The live confirmed record cannot replace independently authenticated applied payment authority.

vectors.name: consumer-included-only-refused
vectors.note: An included label without a record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-pending-refused
vectors.note: A pending record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-unavailable-refused
vectors.note: An unreachable node supplies no execution result.

vectors.name: consumer-finalized-alias-refused
vectors.note: Only the exact confirmed status is admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-success-alias-refused
vectors.note: The fixture-codec word success is not a Demos record status.

vectors.name: consumer-case-variant-refused
vectors.note: Status comparison is exact for consumers too.

vectors.name: consumer-unpinned-node-refused
vectors.note: A confirmed record from a node that only self-reports the pinned commit is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-old-build-node-refused
vectors.note: An attested build of another commit lacks the pinned execution-record semantics.

vectors.name: consumer-dirty-build-node-refused
vectors.note: The pinned commit built from a modified tree is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-confirmed-no-op-apply
vectors.note: Authenticated applied-payment authority shows the edit-less confirmed send moved nothing: the evidence is refuted.

vectors.name: consumer-confirmed-no-op-copied-authority
vectors.note: An authority that reports a committed payment for a record without the send's edits is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-partial-edits
vectors.note: A record carrying only the payment's two balance edits is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-reordered-edit-members
vectors.note: A record whose edit members are reordered is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-four-edits-uncommitted-payment
vectors.note: Authenticated committed balances unchanged by a confirmed send with all four edits refute the payment.

vectors.name: consumer-four-edits-authority-not-committed-change
vectors.note: An authority whose debit and credit are not the change of its committed balances is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-hash-unauthenticated
vectors.note: A record for another transaction hash does not bind the signed txHash.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-hash-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record for another hash contradicts the signed txHash.

vectors.name: consumer-failed-fails
vectors.note: A bound failed record, authenticated under FV-5, refutes the success evidence.

vectors.name: consumer-failed-unauthenticated
vectors.note: A failed record from a plain RPC read is not an authenticated refutation; the evidence stays indeterminate.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read that pays another payee does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-block-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read in another block does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payer-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read from another payer does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-amount-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record for another amount is fail.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record paying another payee is fail.

vectors.name: delivery-after-all-gates
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record, FV-5-authenticated, with SB-1, SB-2 and PB passing, authorizes delivery.

vectors.name: delivery-record-unauthenticated
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record from a plain RPC read is not BFT-final proof; no delivery.

vectors.name: delivery-dem7-pending
vectors.note: FV, SB and PB passing do not replace an executed record.

vectors.name: delivery-fv-indeterminate
vectors.note: Without verified BFT finality the confirmed record authorizes nothing.

vectors.name: delivery-sb1-fails
vectors.note: A confirmed transfer cited under another anchor tuple is rejected by SB-1.

vectors.name: delivery-pb-fails
vectors.note: A confirmed transfer to a destination outside the agreement is rejected by PB.

vectors.name: delivery-hash-admitted-for-another-job
vectors.note: pay-dem has no settlement-side job binding: a demos:{txHash} the payee already admitted for another job makes the group indeterminate.

vectors.name: delivery-hash-admitted-legacy-spelling-for-another-job
vectors.note: A verified legacy 0x/upper-case spelling admitted for another job collapses to the same demos:{txHash}; the group is indeterminate.

vectors.name: delivery-admitted-reference-noncanonical
vectors.note: An admitted current reference that cannot produce the canonical SB-1 key is malformed; it is never silently skipped.

vectors.name: delivery-hash-admitted-for-another-phase
vectors.note: The same collision rule applies to another phase index of the same job.

vectors.name: delivery-same-tuple-readmitted
vectors.note: Re-presenting the same evidence for the same tuple is idempotent.

vectors.name: confirmed-non-native-type
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: confirmed-uppercase-recipient
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: confirmed-uppercase-send-argument
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: confirmed-non-native-tag
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: confirmed-extra-send-member
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: confirmed-extra-send-argument
vectors.note: Every native-send profile member is checked exactly.

vectors.name: consumer-non-native-type-refused
vectors.note: A non-native type never settles.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-non-native-type
vectors.note: A send-shaped escrow transaction is not a native transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-numeric-os-amount
vectors.note: Post-fork signed amounts use canonical OS strings, never DEM-interpreted JSON numbers.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-numeric-os-fee
vectors.note: Post-fork signed fee amounts use canonical OS strings.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-fee-object-missing
vectors.note: The signed fee object must be present.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-fee-member-missing
vectors.note: All three signed fee amounts must be present.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-numeric-rpc-fee
vectors.note: rpc_fee is a canonical OS string, never a DEM number.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-numeric-additional-fee
vectors.note: additional_fee is a canonical OS string, never a DEM number.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-noncanonical-fee-string
vectors.note: A fee string with a leading zero is not canonical.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-fee-members-reordered
vectors.note: The node rebuilds the fee object in network, rpc, additional, rpc_address order before re-deriving the hash.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-rpc-address-omitted

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-extra-fee-member

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-timestamp-missing
vectors.note: The node converts the signed timestamp with BigInt; an absent one is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-fractional-timestamp
vectors.note: A fractional timestamp is not a BigInt value.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-timestamp-zero
vectors.note: sign() replaces a zero timestamp with Date.now(); zero is not positive.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-negative-timestamp
vectors.note: A negative timestamp is not positive.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-string-timestamp
vectors.note: The signed timestamp is a JSON integer; BigInt would accept a decimal string, the profile does not.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-numeric-rpc-address
vectors.note: rpc_address is null or a string, never a number.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-string-nonce

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-ed25519-address-missing

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-ed25519-address-mismatch

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-edits-missing

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-edits-extra-credit

vectors.name: confirmed-string-block-number

vectors.note: A consumer without the inclusion block's ID cannot bind the applied-payment authority.

vectors.name: sign-with-pinned-node-and-applied-payment-authority
vectors.note: A binding that pins nodes and configures applied-payment authority lets the handler sign.

vectors.name: sign-without-pinned-node
vectors.note: Without a pinned node no record binds: ok false, permanent, before pay() or sign().

vectors.name: sign-without-applied-payment-authority
vectors.note: Without applied-payment authority DEM-3 success is unreachable: ok false, permanent, nothing signed.

vectors.name: sign-without-binding
vectors.note: With neither configured the refusal is still permanent, never substrate.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-canonical
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-legacy-spelling
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-current-prefixed
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-current-uppercase
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-malformed
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb1-demos-short
vectors.note: Project a verified raw Demos ChainTxRef to the byte-identical settlement ID.

vectors.name: sb2-demos-two-job-collision
vectors.note: Derive keys before grouping; no job, block or legacy spelling may split one transfer.

vectors.name: sb2-demos-distinct-hash-control
vectors.note: Derive keys before grouping; no job, block or legacy spelling may split one transfer.

vectors.name: sb2-demos-legacy-spelling-collision
vectors.note: Derive keys before grouping; no job, block or legacy spelling may split one transfer.

vectors.name: confirm-after-durable-retention
vectors.note: The confirm request is the first egress: it may carry the signed transfer once it is durably retained.

vectors.name: confirm-before-durable-retention
vectors.note: confirmTx hands the signed bytes to a node, which can submit them; retention must be durable first.

vectors.name: sr3-proxy-submission-refused
vectors.note: pay-dem defines no SR-3 proxy submission: a durably retained, authentic transfer is still not sent that way.

vectors.name: wallet-direct-submission-refused
vectors.note: A wallet call that submits the signed bytes without confirm, such as an SDK helper, is not a profile route.

vectors.name: broadcast-completes-own-confirm
vectors.note: The one broadcast that completes the uninterrupted submission whose confirm just returned, carrying that confirm's validity response.

vectors.name: broadcast-validity-response-missing
vectors.note: A broadcast that carries no validity response sends nothing the handler retained.

vectors.name: broadcast-stale-validity-response
vectors.note: A validity response from an earlier confirm is not the one this submission's confirm returned.

vectors.name: broadcast-validity-response-other-transaction
vectors.note: The node executes the embedded transaction: a same-sender payment of another amount is not the retained transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-validity-response-other-nonce
vectors.note: An embedded transfer with another nonce is another transaction, however it is signed.

vectors.name: broadcast-validity-response-not-valid
vectors.note: confirmTx answers result 200 with valid false when it refuses the transfer; that response completes nothing.

vectors.name: broadcast-validity-response-resigned-content
vectors.note: Embedded content re-serialized in another member order hashes differently from the retained signed bytes.

vectors.name: rebroadcast-after-interrupted-confirm-refused
vectors.note: After a confirm timeout, error or restart the node may have submitted the bytes; only re-reads follow.

vectors.name: replacement-after-interrupted-confirm-refused
vectors.note: A restart after confirm never signs a replacement transfer for the same phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-without-applied-payment-authority
vectors.note: Without applied-payment authority DEM-3 success is unreachable, so nothing is signed or sent.

vectors.name: confirm-without-applied-payment-authority
vectors.note: The binding precondition holds at the confirm request too.

vectors.name: broadcast-without-pinned-node
vectors.note: Without a pinned node no record binds, so nothing is signed or sent.

vectors.name: broadcast-hash-uppercase
vectors.note: The node compares the derived hash exactly, so an upper-case hash is refused even when signed as spelled.

vectors.name: broadcast-oversized-phase-amount
vectors.note: The phase DEM amount converts to OS by spelling; an oversized amount is compared, not refused by int().

vectors.name: record-oversized-amount
vectors.note: An oversized OS amount decodes as a canonical string and is unbound; it never aborts the handler.

vectors.name: record-oversized-nonce
vectors.note: An oversized nonce decodes as a canonical string and is unbound.

vectors.name: applied-transfer-oversized-debit
vectors.note: An applied debit other than the OS amount, however long, is no proof of payment.

vectors.name: consumer-oversized-record-amount
vectors.note: An oversized record amount is compared with the phase by spelling and does not bind.

vectors.name: consumer-oversized-amount-bound
vectors.note: A large amount that every source spells the same way still binds.

vectors.name: apr-evidence-plain-rpc-failure-proof
vectors.note: The pin does not authenticate an RPC read, so the handler's terminal proof authorizes no replacement job.

vectors.name: apr-evidence-authenticated-failure-proof
vectors.note: The same failed record authenticated under FV-5 at its bft-final inclusion is reconciliation evidence.
